name: ai-vercel-build-analyzer
description: Vercel build process analyzer that diagnoses build failures with precision. Parses Vercel build logs to identify exact failure points, distinguishes between build-time and runtime errors, detects package resolution issues, identifies webpack/vite configuration problems, analyzes memory and timeout errors during build, checks for missing dependencies or version conflicts, validates build commands and scripts, identifies issues with build output size (50MB limit for serverless, 10k file limit), detects problems with ISR/SSG generation, and provides specific fixes rather than generic suggestions. Understands npm/yarn/pnpm differences and their impact on Vercel builds.
